name: Imaginary Realm 2 -Absolute Scenario-
source: Orem and Yumbrad had caused the entire Demon Race to fall under Rosey. In order to regain their freedom, Yumbrad decided to send Orem to join a Costume Competition. Your task is to help Orem to get the best costume and win the contest. You will get different ending depending on which costume you choose.
